_provenance.how: read from the committed sources, not from a live call: the emitters are DeletionRefusedException and the four Actions below, and the wire shape is the controller's 409 body
_provenance.note: ADR-0013 deliberately assigns NO numeric OSPP code to these four doors. DeletionRefusedException.php:31-37 states why: the registry holds 121 codes and none means 'refused because something still references this' — 3016 ACTIVE_SESSIONS_PRESENT fits one of the six causes and not the other five.

organization.wire_shape_note: the odd one out — NOT DeletionRefusedException; body is { error, message, in_flight_payments }

refusals.message: Cannot delete this organization: 1 payment(s) are still in flight. Deleting it now would strand that money — the settlement read would refuse a deleted tenant and leave the intent pending forever, and a refund needs the merchant credentials that deletion takes away. Wait for the payments to settle (payment:poll-webpay runs every minute), or suspend the organization instead — suspension stops new business and lets payments already taken finish.
refusals.teaches: wait for settlement, or suspend instead
